text: This report provides an analysis of the results of the Request for Proposals for new Zoomobiles and recommends the award for approval by the Board of Management.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Recommended that the RFP for the purchasing of four (4) people mover trams, in accordance with the People Mover Vehicle (Zoomobile) RFP 03 (2018-10), be awarded to TDI Production Services in the amount of $1,993,500 including applicable taxes.
